blocks.content:
Age: 13.8 billion years
Galaxy: Milky Way
Nearest Star: Sun
Largest Planet: Jupiter
Hottest Planet: Venus
Dwarf Planet: Pluto

items: Venus is identified as the hottest planet in the solar system.
Pluto is classified specifically as a dwarf planet.
The Sun is recognized as the nearest star.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The age of the universe is 13.8 billion years.
Our galaxy is the Milky Way and the nearest star is the Sun.
Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
Venus is the hottest planet, while Pluto is classified as a dwarf planet.
